Shows the clock each time the screen turns off
An always-on clock for phones whose built-in one switches off after a few seconds.
Show the clock when the screen turns off
Lets the app open the clock by itself when the screen turns off.
Under Other permissions, allow Show on Lock screen. Without it the clock stays hidden behind the lock screen.
Xiaomi: pop-up windows in the background
Under Other permissions, allow Open new windows while running in the background, only if the clock still does not appear.
